summary: You take an ILAC course with a significant Iberian component and one with a significant Latin American component, then ILAC courses and up to 12 units of second-year or higher Spanish language, at least six courses of 3 units or more and 23 units in all, all letter graded. A different ILAC course for either component, independent study, BOSP courses (up to 10 units) and one outside course (up to 5 units) need the Director of Undergraduate Studies' approval and are moved in by hand. The units cannot count toward another major or minor, and AP credit is not accepted; you check those yourself.

eyI7p0zS.why: Elective sources with caps: "Up to 12 second-year or above Spanish language units ... Independent Study courses may count ... Up to 10 units of pre-approved BOSP coursework ... One approved 3-5 unit course (5 units maximum) from outside ILAC or the Language Center." The 23-unit minimum is the program's. The ILAC and Spanish language electives are pools below; this rule takes the approved courses, moved in by hand.
